characters.name: Halvor
characters.description: En gutt som helst sitter ved peisen og roter i aska, men som blir modig nok til å møte tre troll og gå helt til Soria Moria for prinsessa si.
characters.look: A tall, lanky lad of about eighteen with a lazy slouch, a long face, a long straight nose, sleepy half-closed hazel eyes, a slow lopsided smile and messy auburn hair falling over his forehead. His cheeks are smudged with soot. He wears a ragged, soot-streaked grey wool shirt with holes at the elbows, baggy patched brown trousers held up with a piece of rope, and battered brown shoes, with a charred poking stick tucked into the rope.

characters.name: Halvor i fine klær
characters.description: Halvor etter at prinsessene har gitt ham klær så fine at han kunne vært en kongssønn.
characters.look: A tall, lanky lad of about eighteen with a long face, a long straight nose, sleepy hazel eyes, a lopsided smile and messy auburn hair, now washed clean and dressed like a king's son: a royal-blue velvet coat with gold buttons and gold-embroidered cuffs, a white linen shirt with a frilled collar, a wide lingonberry-red sash, cream breeches, white stockings and shiny black buckled shoes.

characters.name: Den eldste prinsessa
characters.description: Den eldste av de tre prinsessene. Hun sitter ved rokken i det første slottet og liker å ha det ryddig.
characters.look: A tall, stately princess of about twenty-four with warm golden-brown skin, a long oval face, a straight nose, calm dark-brown eyes, neat arched eyebrows and thick black hair coiled into two round buns over her ears. She wears a small gold crown, a long plum-purple velvet dress with a high collar and long sleeves, and a crisp white apron with a lace edge, because she likes everything tidy.

characters.name: Den mellomste prinsessa
characters.description: Den mellomste av de tre prinsessene, som blir så glad når trollet er borte at hun ikke vet hvilket bein hun skal stå på.
characters.look: A short, bouncy princess of about twenty-one with warm golden-brown skin, a round face with dimpled cheeks, a small button nose, merry black eyes and glossy black hair cut in a thick, chin-length bob with a straight fringe. She wears a small gold crown, a long sunflower-yellow dress with puffed sleeves and a wide white sash, and a necklace of big white pearls.

characters.name: Den yngste prinsessa
characters.description: Den yngste og vakreste av de tre prinsessene, som gir Halvor en ønskering og ber ham aldri si et ord om dem.
characters.look: A graceful, slender princess of about eighteen with warm golden-brown skin, a heart-shaped face, a small straight nose, large, bright dark-brown eyes with long lashes, a warm smile and long, straight, glossy black hair falling loose to her waist. She wears a small gold crown, a long red dress with a square neckline and wide bell sleeves edged with gold braid, and a tiny gold sun pendant on a thin chain.

characters.name: Trollet med tre hoder
characters.description: Trollet i det første slottet, som snuser med alle tre nesene og brøler «Huttetu!», men går opp i en liten, grå sky når Halvor svinger sverdet.
characters.look: A big, pear-shaped troll about twice as tall as a man, with blue-grey, knobbly skin, long dangling arms and huge flat feet. He has exactly three heads side by side on his broad shoulders, each with a big round nose: the left head is sleepy, with droopy eyelids and a floppy red nightcap; the middle head is grumpy, with one bushy black eyebrow; the right head is surprised, with round eyes and a tuft of white hair. He wears a patched brown leather jerkin tied with rope.

characters.name: Trollet med seks hoder
characters.description: Trollet i det andre slottet. Han er så stor at han må snu seg sidelengs for å komme inn døra, men PUFF! sier han likevel.
characters.look: A huge, barrel-shaped troll about three times as tall as a man, with pale sandstone-yellow skin covered in brown freckles and warts, and shoulders so wide that he must turn sideways to get through doors. He has exactly six heads in one long row along his shoulders, each with a long pointed nose, small beady eyes and a stiff tuft of black hair. He wears a huge patchwork coat sewn from old sacks and goes barefoot.

characters.name: Trollet med ni hoder
characters.description: Det største og seigeste trollet, i det tredje slottet. Han blir blekere og blekere for hver SVISJ, helt til han går opp i en stor, grå sky.
characters.look: An enormous troll as tall as a house, the biggest of all, with dark charcoal-grey skin, rough and lumpy like wet rock, a round belly and thick, stumpy legs. He has exactly nine small, round heads on short, thick necks, spread out in a wide fan above his shoulders, each with a potato nose, bushy white eyebrows and a wide, frog-like mouth. He wears a ragged sheepskin cloak and a belt of knotted rope.

characters.name: Mor
characters.description: Halvors mor, som ler så hun må holde seg på magen, og som kjenner igjen gutten sin når ilden blusser opp.
characters.look: A small, sturdy, quick-moving woman of about fifty with a round chin, a wide mouth made for laughing, a little upturned nose, bright brown eyes and dark-brown hair streaked with grey, tucked under a faded indigo headscarf knotted on top of her head. She wears a patched heather-purple wool dress with rolled-up sleeves, a faded green apron and wooden clogs.

characters.name: Far
characters.description: Halvors far, en stille mann som ser inn i ilden og savner gutten sin.
characters.look: A broad, slow-moving, heavy-set man of about sixty with a big round face, ruddy cheeks, a bulbous nose, a bushy salt-and-pepper beard and a bald head under a knitted blue cap. He wears a worn moss-green wool jacket over a collarless linen shirt, patched brown knee breeches, grey knitted stockings and heavy leather boots.

characters.name: Kona med den lange nesa
characters.description: Ei gammel kone med ei nese så lang at hun roter i glørne med den, som spør månen og vestavinden om veien til Soria Moria og gir Halvor et par støvler for hesten hans.
characters.look: A tall, bony, very old woman with a long thin neck, knobbly hands, a wrinkled, cheerful face, small twinkling black eyes and an enormously long, thin, pointed nose with a rosy tip, as long as a wooden spoon, which she uses to poke the embers. Her dove-grey hair peeps out in wisps from under a white linen cap. She wears a faded heather-blue wool dress, a black apron and wooden clogs.

characters.name: Vestavinden
characters.description: En travel vind som suser inn over skogen på vei til Soria Moria for å tørke bryllupsklærne, og som lar Halvor henge på så godt han kan.
characters.look: A friendly wind spirit the size of a big man, with a round, rosy, beardless face, a wide merry grin and bright green eyes. His wild, streaming hair is made of whirling leaves and spruce needles, with three wooden clothes-pegs clipped in it, because he dries the washing. From the chest down his body turns into long, curling swirls of misty sea-green and silver air with leaves spinning inside, and he has long, thin, windy arms.

places.name: the Spinning Room
places.look: A warm, high-ceilinged room in the first troll castle, panelled in pale carved pine, with a crackling fire in a big stone fireplace with a wide chimney, a wooden spinning wheel with a three-legged stool in the middle of the floor, a small round table and a narrow wooden shelf on the wall. A tall arched wooden door leads out to a dark corridor, and an open doorway shows a kitchen where gold pots and silver pans hang gleaming.

places.name: the Grand Hall
places.look: The grandest hall of the third troll castle: vast and high, with white stone walls, gilded pillars, a polished floor of blue and white tiles, tall arched windows looking out over blue mountains, and one huge arched double door of dark oak. In one corner stands a big, round, white-and-blue tiled stove, glowing warm, with a brass rail around it.

places.name: the Forest Cottage
places.look: A tiny, crooked log cottage with a sagging grass roof and one small window glowing orange, deep in a huge, dark spruce forest that never ends. A thin curl of smoke rises from its stone chimney. Behind it lies a little clearing, and beside it a small garden with a wattle fence, a few cabbages and a lopsided gate.

Through the door, far down the hill, a big sailing ship lies at anchor on the sea in bright morning light.
